import pandas as pd

def validate(frame):
    assert {"id", "score"}.issubset(frame.columns)
    assert frame["id"].is_unique
    assert frame["score"].dropna().between(0, 100).all()

example = pd.DataFrame({"id": [1, 2], "score": [80, 90]})
validate(example)
print("valid")
